To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) TSVs and 3D interconnects can be used for partitioning and integration of different functions in a wireless system, 2) TSV and 2.5D integration can be implemented with a low impact on the final product functionality and 3) 3D integration can improve the package level reliability of the final product.

(i) TSVs are a viable solution for 3D integration of a wireless system-on-package, and (ii) 3D integration does not impact the functionality of the wireless system and does not degrade the package level reliability of a wireless system.
3D integration of a wireless product has been demonstrated without impacting product functionality and package level reliability.
